body.prompt: Create an animated Button component using CSS Modules. MUST use named export 'export const Button: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ...'. MUST define TypeScript interface 'ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>' explicitly declaring 'onClick?: (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;' and ': string' (label?: string;) and ': boolean' (isLoading?: boolean;) props. MUST pass 'onClick={onClick}', 'disabled={disabled}', 'tabIndex={0}', 'onKeyDown', and at least one 'aria-' attribute (e.g. aria-label, aria-busy) on the element. Support variants (primary, secondary, danger, ghost), sizes (sm, md, lg), and Remix Icons.
